description.value: City-run campground in a forested setting on High Street just east of downtown Nelson, within walking distance of shops, parks, and the beach. Amenities include showers, laundry, and cooking facilities; open May 1–October 16 with tent sites from $26/night.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The City of Nelson website provides detailed, current information about this municipally operated campground.
